method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the complainant, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05; dates, business days and the regulative vocabulary in one shared module (built-in date functions, no daydate), then two rule modules (making and dealing with a complaint; investigation, conciliation and protections), each exported question calling rules defined beside it, and a worked-case file for each; two regulative rules (decide-then-tell for ss 35, 49, 50 with s 278; tell for s 278) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Health Ombudsman Act 2013 (Qld), act-2013-036, the version in force from 2026-04-10 (current on 2026-11-06), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-2013-036.txt (text sha256 6b40976fe42bc5f4fb74aecb49de8cef1f6f8aa28115b9c25ea4eceacb0ef8b7 per its meta.json); converted from the Queensland Legislation HTML view; no instrument brought in (none sets a number the encoded sections use)

seat: the person who makes a health service complaint (the person who received the health service, or a parent, guardian, family member of a person who died, or other person complaining for them); for ss 232, 261-263A and 275 the person who gives information or is harmed for complaining

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run <file> for each of the five .l4 files, from this folder, at most two at a time
checks.result: 159 assertions written, 159 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text and a calendar.

scope: The provisions a complainant meets. In: ss 7, 8, 20-23, 31, 32, 34(4)-(5), 35, 35A, 35K(3), 38(2), 39(2), 44, 47-50, 53-56, 71, 84, 85, 90F, 95, 140, 145(2), (4), 149, 150, 232, 261-263A, 264, 275, 278. Out: preliminary and overview (ss 1-6, 9-19), the office, Minister and committee (parts 2, 13, 14, 16), s 33 and s 34(1)-(3), consultation with Ahpra (divisions 2A, 2B other than s 35K(3)), ss 36, 37, 38(1), (3), 39(1), 40-43A, the practitioner's side of parts 7, 8A, 8AA and 10, ss 80-83, 86-90, part 9, ss 134-139, 141-144, 146-148, part 12, part 15 other than s 232, ss 265-274, 276, 277, 279-281, transitional and regulation-making. Reasons in NOTES.md.
